details: Michael Saylor's firm, Strategy, acquired an additional 3,273 Bitcoin for approximately $255 million at an average price of $77,906 per BTC. This increases their total holdings to 818,334 BTC, demonstrating a continued aggressive accumulation strategy, funded by selling Class A common stock.
title: Michael Saylor's Strategy Adds 3,273 BTC for $255M, Holdings Top 818K

details: Global crypto investment products, predominantly Bitcoin-based, recorded $1.2 billion in net inflows last week. This marks a fourth consecutive week of positive flows, signaling improving institutional demand despite upcoming Federal Reserve meetings.
title: Bitcoin Funds Attract $1.2 Billion in Weekly Inflows, Institutional Demand Rises

details: Japanese Bitcoin treasury firm Metaplanet Inc. plans to raise approximately $137 million through a third-party allotment of newly issued shares and stock acquisition rights. A significant portion of these funds (around $91.2M) is intended for acquiring additional Bitcoin, further solidifying its "Bitcoin Standard" strategy.
title: Japan's Metaplanet to Raise $137M for Bitcoin Accumulation

details: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan has warned that up to $6 trillion in US bank deposits could migrate to stablecoins if issuers are allowed to pay interest. This potential shift, representing a significant portion of commercial bank deposits, could impact banks' lending capacity.
title: BofA CEO Warns $6T Bank Deposits Could Move to Stablecoins

details: Six US Senators have questioned Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche regarding the shutdown of the Department of Justice's crypto enforcement team in April 2025. They allege a potential conflict of interest, as Blanche reportedly held substantial cryptocurrency holdings while making the decision.
title: US Senators Question DOJ Over Crypto Crime Unit Shutdown and Official's Holdings

details: French prosecutors have indicted 88 individuals, including minors, in connection with violent "wrench attacks" targeting cryptocurrency owners. These crimes involve physical force to extort crypto, with 47 incidents recorded in 2026 alone, highlighting a rising trend in organized crypto-related crime.
title: France Indicts 88 Individuals Over Violent Crypto "Wrench Attacks"

details: Michael Egorov, founder of Curve, has proposed a new market-based mechanism to recover bad debt in DeFi lending, aiming to turn distressed positions into tradable investment products. This initiative follows the KelpDAO fallout, which intensified debates on how DeFi protocols should handle loan shortfalls.
title: Curve Founder Proposes Market-Based DeFi Bad Debt Recovery Model

details: While Bitcoin briefly touched $122,800, several altcoins like Solana (up 9%) and Dogecoin (up 8%) recorded significantly larger percentage increases in the last 24 hours, indicating a rotating market leadership and strong altcoin momentum.
title: Altcoins See Stronger Percentage Gains Than Bitcoin

details: The total market capitalization for NFTs fell by 12% from $9.3 billion to $8.1 billion, coinciding with a 9% drop in Ethereum's price. Major collections like CryptoPunks and Bored Apes experienced significant value losses.
title: NFT Market Cap Drops 12% as Ethereum Declines
